description: Read a job submitted with everyinfra_call_api(mode=async). Free; it does not count against the per-minute limit. While status is submitting / running / finalizing, check again later; succeeded: the rows are in results (paged actions also return next_page_token); failed: see error.reason and error.charged; submit_unknown: the submission is still being confirmed — do not resubmit, follow next_action. Only jobs submitted with the same API key are visible.

job_id.description: The job_id returned by an async everyinfra_call_api

name: everyinfra_get_job
title: Get an async job
